goal: 完成 Task 4W：以 migration 0032 建立 owner-scoped Exact import jobs、独立 worker 数据库角色、数据库主导的 lease/retention/metrics 和受限 worker service；不激活 API、UI 或 SimC 用户路径。
userValue: 后续 Exact-first 导入可以由最小权限、可追溯且会在失败时明确冷却或阻断的后台链路处理，而不会让公开应用角色拥有 authority 写入或 job 管理权限。
nonGoals: 不修改任何 v1 canonical bytes、key、hash、历史行、generation 35、Catalog 或 Manifest pointer。
不修改 Task 3A、Task 4P 或 Task 4L 的 canonical owner、typed verifier 或历史 packet。
不激活 Exact import API、typed UI contract、SimC task consumer、生产 migration、用户可见 worker 路径或异步 Catalog backflow。
migration、service 或 deploy script 不创建角色、不启用 LOGIN、不授予 CREATEROLE，也不使用 WOW_DATABASE_URL 作为 worker 数据源。
不把 raw profile、角色名、服务器名、realm 或其它可识别输入写入 canonical job request、数据库、日志或证据。

docs/postgres-identity-migration-runbook.md and current status control-plane files for the independently provisioned role/DSN/candidate/rollback procedure and Task 4W truth.

Static SQL tests for 0032 identity, role and core-function preflight, row state, index/function signature, fixed search_path, security-definer revoke/grant boundary and no dynamic SQL.

Focused local fake-store tests, direct-server imports, independent scoped CR, final exact-head CI and Harness-selected fresh evidence.

ownership.factOwner: PostgreSQL 0032 functions own queue state, time, owner isolation, lease CAS, terminalization, retention and aggregate metrics; the worker owns only its explicit worker-role connection and typed request/result handling.
consumers: future Task 5A API consumer only after its own separate authorization
ownership.roleBoundary: wow_exact_worker is pre-provisioned NOLOGIN; an operator-created LOGIN member is the only worker connection principal, which must SET ROLE wow_exact_worker immediately. wow_app receives only owner-scoped enqueue/read execution.

engineeringHealth.reason: Task 3B persistence is archived and its final candidate was disposed. Task 4W starts with no runtime consumer; the later candidate is blocked until cloud preflight confirms the existing worker group role, login membership, three distinct redacted DSNs and bounded capacity.

acceptanceEvidence: Canonical exact-import-job-request-v1 bytes and key are rebuilt and fail closed on schema, dependency-vector or recursively sensitive-field drift.
0032 keeps wow_app table-DML-free, exposes only the declared owner/worker functions, gives PUBLIC no function execution and verifies every worker connection through its dedicated DSN plus SET ROLE.
Database time and lock tokens govern enqueue, claim, heartbeat, terminalize, failed cooldown and bounded retention; wrong or expired tokens produce no state change.

Fresh and upgrade disposable PostgreSQL candidates prove role/ACL isolation, owner isolation, concurrent deterministic enqueue, reclaim, terminal metrics and prune limits without a production migration or active user path.

candidateDeployment.beforeMerge: Run one final-head cloud-only disposable PostgreSQL candidate after local RED/GREEN and independent scoped CR. It must use operator-provisioned fresh and upgrade databases plus distinct migrator/app/worker login DSNs, bounded resources and no production service activation.
candidateDeployment.rollback: Code and dormant service-contract rollback; discard only the two explicit Task 4W disposable candidate databases after archive identity checks and main/origin parity.

closureCondition: Task 4W may advance from implementation_allowed only after scoped independent review, fresh local focused verification, one final-head cloud-only fresh/upgrade PostgreSQL candidate, exact-head CI and Harness User Acceptance Closure. It remains non-user-visible until a separately authorized API/runtime consumer task.

decisionLog.decision: After Task 3A, Task 4P, Task 4L and Task 3B closure, the user explicitly authorized continuous Exact-first progression without step-by-step reauthorization. Task 4W is selected as the next frozen allowlisted stage, bounded to 0032 and dormant worker infrastructure only.

Task 4W will not create or activate database roles. Candidate evidence must independently prove a pre-provisioned NOLOGIN worker group, a separate LOGIN member and worker-only DSN before any migration or service claim.
